claims.claim_text: Desktop Metal operates manufacturing/HQ at corporate headquarters in Burlington, Massachusetts (~110,000 sq ft of office and building space; uses for manufacturing, R&D, warehousing).
claims.subject: Desktop Metal
claims.source_quote: Desktop Metal s corporate headquarters are located in Burlington, Massachusetts. As of December 31, 2023, we leased approximately 110,000 square feet of office and building space ... We use these facilities primarily for manufacturing, research and development, warehousing, sales, marketing and administration.

claims.claim_text: EnvisionTEC US LLC operates a manufacturing/product compliance facility in Dearborn, Michigan (subject to whistleblower investigation re manufacturing practices; FDA-regulated products including Flexcera resins).
claims.subject: EnvisionTEC US LLC (Desktop Metal subsidiary)
claims.object_value: Dearborn, MI (manufacturing of FDA-regulated dental products)
claims.source_quote: the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors engaged a third party to conduct an independent internal investigation as a result of a whistleblower complaint relating to manufacturing and product compliance practices at its EnvisionTEC US LLC facility in Dearborn, Michigan.

claims.claim_text: Desktop Metal is supported by over 1,000 patents or pending patent applications across its proprietary additive manufacturing technologies (metals, polymers, ceramics, sands, etc.).
claims.subject: Desktop Metal
claims.source_quote: are supported by over 1,000 patents or pending patent applications.

claims.claim_text: Desktop Metal operates internationally with significant locations including Germany (the ExOne European HQ in Gersthofen, Germany is an active operating facility under a multi-year lease through 2027).
claims.subject: ExOne (Desktop Metal subsidiary)
claims.object_value: ExOne European HQ in Gersthofen, Germany
claims.source_quote: In February 2022, the Company amended its existing facility lease for the ExOne European headquarters and operating facility in Gersthofen, Germany, extending the lease term ... through December 2027 ... aggregate annual rent totaling $1.7 million.

claims.claim_text: Desktop Metal entered a definitive merger agreement with Stratasys Ltd. on May 25, 2023 (subsequently terminated) — a publicly disclosed transaction with a US-listed counterparty.
claims.subject: Desktop Metal
claims.source_quote: On May 25, 2023, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger ... by and among Stratasys Ltd. ... Tetris Sub Inc. ... and the Company, pursuant to which Merger Sub was to merge with and into the Company.

claims.claim_text: Desktop Metal sells its Additive Manufacturing 2.0 hardware/parts/materials platform globally; distinctive brand name 'Desktop Metal' should appear in customer/supplier/competitor public filings.
claims.subject: Desktop Metal
claims.object_value: Desktop Metal brand mentioned in US-listed-filer disclosures
claims.source_quote: We leverage our core competencies ... by marketing and selling our Additive Manufacturing 2.0 solutions through a leading global distribution network ... covers over 40 countries around the world.

claims.claim_text: Desktop Metal's Desktop Health subsidiary commercializes FDA-cleared/regulated dental products (e.g., Flexcera resins); manufactured at EnvisionTEC's Michigan facility.
claims.subject: Desktop Metal / Desktop Health / EnvisionTEC
claims.object_value: Flexcera dental resins, PCA4000 curing box (recalled)
claims.source_quote: the Company also initiated voluntary recalls of certain shipments of Flexcera resins and the PCA4000 curing box.

claims.claim_text: ExOne Company (acquired subsidiary) operated multiple US manufacturing/operations sites in Pennsylvania (its pre-acquisition HQ was North Huntingdon, PA).
claims.subject: ExOne (Desktop Metal subsidiary)
claims.source_quote: Campanella asserts breach of fiduciary duty claims against former directors and officers of The ExOne Company and aiding and abetting claims against Desktop Metal in connection with the ExOne Merger.

C-001.rationale: Burlington MA HQ supposedly has manufacturing; check EPA FRS for industrial registration. R&D + light assembly may not require EPA registration; treat absence as weak signal per heuristic 1.

C-002.rationale: Dearborn MI manufacturing facility for resin-based dental products; resin/curing processes may be EPA-registered.

C-003.rationale: Verify scale of granted-patent portfolio and presence in claimed tech areas.

C-004.rationale: ExOne was its own NYSE-listed firm prior to acquisition; should have substantial filing footprint.

C-005.rationale: Stratasys (SSYS, CIK 0001517396) should disclose the merger in its filings if it really happened.

C-006.rationale: 'Desktop Metal' is a distinctive 2-word phrase; should have substantial footprint as public co + counterparty mentions.

C-007.rationale: EnvisionTEC has FDA-regulated dental products; check Drugs@FDA listing (note: dental resins are likely 510(k) device, not Drugs@FDA — expect 0 hits, treat as recipe-misfit if so).

C-008.rationale: ExOne pre-acquisition was a PA-HQ binder-jet sand-printing OEM; sand/binder operations typically require EPA registration.

C-001.M_value: n_facilities=4 (Burlington x2, Lexington, Woburn — all greater Boston / Middlesex County)
C-001.interpretation: EPA FRS confirms 4 Desktop Metal facilities registered in MA, including 1 NORTH AVE Burlington (the HQ) plus a second Burlington site (63 Third Ave), and Lexington/Woburn satellite sites. Strong corroboration of the company's MA operating footprint.

C-002.M_value: n_facilities=2 (Dearborn @ 15162 S Commerce Dr, Ferndale @ 1100 Hilton Rd)
C-002.interpretation: EPA FRS confirms the Dearborn EnvisionTEC facility named in the whistleblower disclosure exists at the implied address, plus a second site in Ferndale. The resin/curing operations are exactly the kind of process that registers with EPA. Backs up the existence of the facility named in legal/whistleblower context.

C-003.interpretation: USPTO ODP shows 115 granted patents pre-cutoff with at least one match in claimed categories ({'binder_jet_metal': 174, 'polymer_dental': 1, 'ceramics_sands': 9}). Real portfolio exists.

C-004.M_value: total_hits=296 across SEC filings; ExOne Co (CIK 0001561627) and Desktop Metal both file extensively referencing ExOne
C-004.interpretation: ExOne was an independent NYSE-listed binder-jet 3D-printing OEM (CIK 0001561627) prior to its 2021 acquisition by Desktop Metal — its 10-Ks/8-Ks plus DM's post-acquisition references generate 296 hits. The German Gersthofen facility itself is foreign so not directly checkable via EPA FRS (per recipe applies_when), but the entity's reality and the legal-proceeding references to the ExOne Merger fully corroborate the existence of an active operating subsidiary with the disclosed lease.

C-005.M_value: total_hits=33 in Stratasys filings (default forms only show 2 in the two 20-Fs; expanded with 6-K shows 33). Stratasys is an Israeli foreign issuer that files 20-F + 6-K rather than 10-K/8-K.
C-005.interpretation: Stratasys's own SEC filings extensively disclose Desktop Metal: 2 mentions in 20-F annuals (2022 + 2023) and 33 total when 6-K current reports are included. Per heuristic 2 (foreign-issuer ADR: 0-2 = NORMAL), even the default-form figure passes; the expanded number strongly corroborates the merger and its termination. Counterparty disclosure is real.

C-006.M_value: total_hits=362 across SEC filings; appears in DM's own filings, Trine SPAC predecessor, ExOne, Stratasys, and others
C-006.interpretation: 362 hits substantially exceeds the >=10 PASS threshold for external_brand_validation. The brand has a real footprint across SPAC predecessor (Trine), acquisition target (ExOne), prospective merger partner (Stratasys), and other unrelated filers. No deception signal.

C-007.interpretation: Recipe misfit. Drugs@FDA covers NDAs/ANDAs; dental resins and curing boxes are 510(k)-cleared medical devices in the FDA Device 510(k) database, not Drugs@FDA. The 0-result here does not contradict the claim — it simply indicates the wrong M-source for this regulatory pathway. The whistleblower disclosure itself (acknowledging FDA-notified voluntary recalls of Flexcera and PCA4000) functions as a direct admission of an FDA-regulated product line, so the claim is internally consistent even though the chosen M-source cannot validate.

C-008.M_value: n_facilities=1 (THE EXONE CO @ 127 INDUSTRY BLVD, IRWIN, PA — Westmoreland County)
C-008.interpretation: EPA FRS confirms an active EPA-registered ExOne industrial facility in Irwin, PA (Westmoreland County, the same area as ExOne's pre-acquisition North Huntingdon HQ). Sand/binder-jet operations exactly match the kind of industrial process that registers with EPA. Strong PASS.
